import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Display the first few rows of each dataset to understand their structure
pollen_df.head(), time_series_df.head(), capital_df.head()

# Check the columns related to daggers in the time_series_df and capital_df
time_series_df[['CE', 'Dagger', 'Dagger_inter']].head(), capital_df[['BCE', 'ZDolch']].head()

# Check the range of years in the datasets
time_series_df[['CE', 'calBP']].describe(), capital_df[['BCE']].describe()

# Analyze trends in dagger-related Z values over time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Plot dagger Z values from time_series_data.csv
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger'], label='Dagger (time_series_data)')
plt.plot(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger_inter'], label='Dagger Interpolated (time_series_data)')
plt.xlabel('CE')
plt.ylabel('Z Value')
plt.title('Trend in Dagger Z Values over Time (time_series_data)')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Plot dagger Z values from capital.csv
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.plot(capital_df['BCE'], capital_df['ZDolch'], label='ZDolch (capital)')
plt.xlabel('BCE')
plt.ylabel('Z Value')
plt.title('Trend in Dagger Z Values over Time (capital)')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Perform statistical analysis to identify trends in dagger Z values over time
from scipy.stats import linregress

# Analyze trends in time_series_data.csv
slope_time_series, intercept_time_series, r_value_time_series, p_value_time_series, std_err_time_series = linregress(time_series_df['CE'], time_series_df['Dagger_inter'])
print(f"Trend in Dagger Z Values (time_series_data): Slope = {slope_time_series}, p-value = {p_value_time_series}")

# Analyze trends in capital.csv
slope_capital, intercept_capital, r_value_capital, p_value_capital, std_err_capital = linregress(capital_df['BCE'], capital_df['ZDolch'])
print(f"Trend in Dagger Z Values (capital): Slope = {slope_capital}, p-value = {p_value_capital}")
